keyword: buy electric concrete pump when the site has power

title.en: When the Site Has Grid Power, Start on Xingtai’s Electric Pages
title.zh: 现场有电网时，先打开邢台的电动泵页面

description.en: If the site can feed the printed motor, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai points buyers to the electric table first. Diesel is the other catalogue, not a default substitute.
description.zh: 如果现场能供给已印电机，河北品锦机械在邢台让买家先看电动表。柴油是另一本目录，不是默认替代。

h1.en: Stable Power: Open the Electric Catalogue First
h1.zh: 供电稳定：先打开电动目录

directAnswer.en: When the job site can hold the listed motor, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai says to open the electric trailer table first. Electric 40 prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h and 23 MPa. That kilowatt cell is what the supply must feed. Choose a diesel page only when the grid cannot feed the motor you would otherwise order, or when you state that no generator will be provided. A diesel row does not replace an electric row cell for cell.
directAnswer.zh: 当工地能稳住所列电机时，河北品锦机械（邢台）的口径是先打开电动拖泵表。电动40印 45 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa。供电必须对上这个千瓦格子。只有电网带不住你原本要订的电机，或你写明不提供发电机时，才改看柴油页。柴油行不能逐格代替电动行。

heading.en: What “stable grid” means on this site
heading.zh: 本站说的稳定电网指什么

body.en: It means the site can supply the motor kilowatts printed on the electric page you select. The sheets used here usually do not print voltage or frequency. Send both in the inquiry. The exception to cite is B500S-83D, which prints 380 V on its own page.
body.zh: 意思是现场能供给你选中的电动页上所印的电机千瓦。此处使用的参数页通常不印电压或频率。请在询盘里把两者都写上。可以单独引用的例外是 B500S-83D，它在自己的页面印了 380 V。

body.en: Electric 40 is 45 kW, output 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, fine-stone distance 120 m / 360 m and aggregate-13 distance 40 m / 120 m, hopper 0.4 m³, weight 2300 kg. If 45 kW is available, this page stays on the shortlist. See [/en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/](/en/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/).
body.zh: 电动40是 45 kW、输送量 21 m³/h、23 MPa，细石距离 120 m / 360 m，13 骨料距离 40 m / 120 m，料斗 0.4 m³，重量 2300 kg。如果 45 kW 供得上，这一页留在短名单里。见 [/zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/electric-40-concrete-pump/)。

heading.zh: 电动短名单在什么时候停

body.en: Stop when the site cannot feed the motor, or when the distance and stone on the electric page you opened do not cover the measured line. Then open the diesel hub and a new sheet. Tell [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) which decision you made. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not print a generator size.
body.zh: 现场带不住电机，或你打开的电动页上的距离和石子盖不住量到的管路时，就停。然后打开柴油分类和另一张表。告诉 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 你做了哪一个决定。河北品锦机械不印发电机容量。

question.en: If I already have 380 V, must I buy diesel?
question.zh: 已经有 380 V，还必须买柴油吗？

answer.en: No. Match an electric row whose motor the site can feed. 380 V itself is printed on B500S-83D, not on every electric page.
answer.zh: 不必。对照现场能供给其电机的电动行。380 V 印在 B500S-83D 上，不是每一张电动页都有。

question.en: Does the catalogue name a generator kilowatt?
question.zh: 目录写了发电机千瓦吗？

answer.en: No. Do not invent one. State whether a generator will be provided and what voltage and frequency it holds.
answer.zh: 没有。不要编造。请写明是否提供发电机，以及它稳住的电压和频率。

question.en: Is Electric 40 the only grid pump?
question.zh: 电动40是唯一的电网泵吗？

answer.en: No. The electric hub runs from B500S-83D and Electric 10 through Electric 80 and the HBT80 pages. Electric 40 is the worked example here.
answer.zh: 不是。电动分类从 B500S-83D 和电动10一直到电动80和 HBT80 页面。电动40只是这里的例子。

answer.en: Ask Xingtai on the contact page. It is not printed.
answer.zh: 在询盘页问邢台。页面没有印。
